integration_notes: Select one LOD FBX at a time; the three files have independent identical hierarchies.
Unity LODGroup setup is not supplied; parent must connect compatible motion controls for each LOD.
Blender steering rotates local Z; wheel spin rotates local Y. FBX axis conversion requires validating Unity transform axes.
Suspension links and shocks are static neutral visual geometry, not constraints or WheelColliders.
Procedural rubber microtexture is Blender-only. Runtime rubber remains solid material.
No textures, gameplay scripts, collisions, engine audio or Unity import changes supplied.
LOD2 removes fine tread and small mechanical detail; intended for distant viewing.
